final_prompt:
I want a habit tracker for myself that runs locally in my browser. It's just for me, with no accounts or login, and the data stays in the browser. This is an MVP: I want to see it working quickly. The thinnest working slice is fine, throwaway structure is fine, and please don't build abstractions. I don't need tests.

Stack: Vite + React + TypeScript (I prefer TypeScript), with localStorage for storage. Run it locally only; don't set up deployment.

Build only these features:
- [ ] Add and edit habits
- [ ] Track multiple habits
- [ ] Daily check-off for each habit
- [ ] Streak counter for each habit
- [ ] Simple 30-day history for each habit

Out of scope: reminders/notifications, and stats and charts.

Look and feel: dark mode by default. Leave other styling, naming and edge-case rules to you. Decide, and note your choices in the final summary.

Where to build: create a new folder for the project. There is no existing code, so don't touch anything outside it.

How to verify: run the app locally and check real behaviour, not just that it compiles. Add two habits and check them off. Reload the page and confirm the data persists. Confirm the streak and the 30-day history display correctly. If a check fails, fix the cause and rerun it. Don't work around it.

Ask me only if you're blocked. Otherwise proceed on reasonable choices and report them.

You're done when the app runs locally, that check passes, and you've given me the command to start it, the checks you ran with their results, and the choices you made.
